Model 2 - Changing evaluation metrics. Using pr-auc

This iteration builds on the initial modelling experiment (Model 1), 
which was run using objects loaded directly from the data preparation 
script. Model 1 was not maintained as a standalone, reproducible file. 
This version establishes the initial XGBoost benchmark and includes 
the training, validation and test evaluation procedures.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(xgboost)          
library(pROC)      
library(here)
library(yardstick)
```
```{r}
model_data <- readRDS(here("Pranav", "data", "t20_wicket_model_data.rds"))
```
```{r}
match_dates <- model_data |>
  distinct(match_id, start_date) |>
  arrange(start_date, match_id)

cutoff_index <- floor(nrow(match_dates) * 0.8)

cutoff_date <- match_dates$start_date[cutoff_index]

train_data <- model_data |>
  filter(start_date <= cutoff_date)

test_data <- model_data |>
  filter(start_date > cutoff_date)

```




Xbgoost matrices

```{r}
y_train <- train_data$wickets
y_test  <- test_data$wickets

t20_train <- train_data |>
  select(-match_id, -start_date, -wickets)

t20_test <- test_data |>
  select(-match_id, -start_date, -wickets)

t20_xgtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = t20_train,
  label = y_train
)

t20_xgtest <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = t20_test,
  label = y_test
)
```

Setting parameters

```{r}
params <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "aucpr",
  max_depth = 6,
  eta = 0.05,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  min_child_weight = 5
)
```

5 fold cv
```{r}
set.seed(35571381)

t20_cv <- xgb.cv(
  params = params,
  data = t20_xgtrain,
  nrounds = 1000,
  nfold = 5,
  early_stopping_rounds = 25,
  print_every_n = 25,
  maximize = TRUE
)

best_nrounds <- t20_cv$evaluation_log$iter[
  which.max(t20_cv$evaluation_log$test_aucpr_mean)
]

best_nrounds
```


Training the final model
```{r}
t20_final <- xgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = t20_xgtrain,
  nrounds = best_nrounds,
  evals = list(
    train = t20_xgtrain),
  print_every_n = 5
)
```

Making Predictions

```{r}
pred_probs <- predict(t20_final, t20_xgtest)
```

pr-auc

```{r}
pr_auc <- pr_auc_vec(
  truth = factor(y_test, levels = c(0, 1)),
  estimate = pred_probs,
  event_level = "second"
)

pr_auc
```

roc-auc

```{r}
roc_auc <- roc_auc_vec(
  truth = factor(y_test, levels = c(0, 1)),
  estimate = pred_probs,
  event_level = "second"
)

roc_auc
```

Calibration

```{r}
calibration <- tibble(
  pred = pred_probs,
  actual = y_test
) |>
  mutate(bucket = ntile(pred, 10)) |>
  group_by(bucket) |>
  summarise(
    mean_pred = mean(pred),
    mean_actual = mean(actual),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(calibration)
```

Saving the model results

```{r}
saveRDS(
  list(
    model = t20_final,
    cv = t20_cv,
    test_data = test_data,
    pred_probs = pred_probs,
    y_test = y_test,
    pr_auc = pr_auc,
    roc_auc = roc_auc
  ),
  here("Pranav", "data", "model_2_results.rds")
)
```
